info.title: Gentamicin and Your Hearing
info.subtitle: How a powerful antibiotic can affect the inner ear

rows.title: What it is
rows.desc: An aminoglycoside antibiotic for serious infections

rows.title: How it acts
rows.desc: Can harm inner-ear hair cells that do not regrow

rows.title: Higher risk
rows.desc: High doses, long courses, weak kidneys, genetics

rows.title: Warning signs
rows.desc: New ringing, muffled hearing, dizziness, unsteadiness

rows.title: Stay protected
rows.desc: Baseline test, monitoring, never stop on your own
